_about: Extra detail for the Gaps page, keyed by kanban task id. The kanban's 'Needs your input' column is the list; this file says what each item blocks, how to deliver it, and where it matters.

t01.how: Watch it on the Review page, add notes there and paste them into the chat. Or just say "approved".

t02.how: Drop the screenshot into video/assets/ and tell me the file name. Blur the UTR, login and the balance first.

t03.how: Record about 15 seconds, drop the file in video/assets/ and tell me the file name.

t04.how: Tell me to keep the AI voice or change it, or drop your recording in video/assets/vo/ (one file per scene, same names as now) and say so.

t05.how: A 20 second n8n canvas capture plus the dashboard. Drop the files in video/assets/ and tell me the names. Blur any client data.

t06.how: Screenshots of the chasers, the receipt and the liquidation-date email, with names and addresses blurred. Drop them in video/assets/.

t07.how: Read the script and tell me anything out of date: £1,500 + £2,100, about two months, the 4.8 Trustpilot rating.

t08.how: Tell me a palette, a font and a music preference, or say "your call".

t32.how: Save the official logo as video/assets/logos/n8n.svg (or .png) and say done, or tell me to download it from n8n's brand page.

t33.how: Confirm the £1,500 + £2,100 really are average UK figures, or tell me to say "what I paid" instead.

t22.how: Send the community name and the link.

t27.how: Send the link once Part 2 is published.

t36.how: Send a clear photo of your face for thumbnail A, or say no.

t39.how: Send the script and the description to your insolvency practitioner and tell me what they change.

t23.how: Ask the practitioner what you may send to creditors and other parties yourself, then tell me whether to keep the line.

t35.how: Say keep it public, make it private, or rewrite the history to remove the figure.

t09.how: Both the fal.ai and DeepInfra keys were pasted in chat. Make new ones in their dashboards, put them in .env, and revoke the old ones.

t37.how: Run  ! gh secret set DEEPINFRA_API_KEY -R rifaterdemsahin/hyperframes  (it asks for the value), then tell me. Or say what you prefer instead.

t38.how: Paste the comment text into the chat. It is not saved in the project files.
